title.label: Just need to iron out some bugs

content.label: I honestly love this app. The free version is good enough to recommend, and I liked it enough to pay for Pro. But there are a couple of bugs that need attention. When I tap the app icon while writing a text message, it kicks me back to the main screen. It also keeps telling me to swipe left or right. That gets frustrating when I’m just trying to finish a message. Fix those two issues, and this could easily be one of the best apps out there.
